scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @goodmom/ui && npm run typecheck -w @goodmom/icons && npm run typecheck -w @goodmom/vue
scripts.build: npm run build -w @goodmom/ui && npm run build -w @goodmom/icons && npm run build -w @goodmom/vue
scripts.publish:vue: npm run build -w @goodmom/vue && npm publish ./goodmom-vue --access public
scripts.publish:icons: npm run build -w @goodmom/icons && npm publish ./goodmom-icons --access public
scripts.publish:ui: npm run build -w @goodmom/ui && npm publish ./goodmom-ui --access public
scripts.publish: npm run publish:icons && npm run publish:ui && npm run publish:vue
